property_summary: For any caller who previously locked a guess for block N, the correct contract rejects settling in block N (requires current block > N), whereas the mutant (>=) allows settling in block N — enabling access to blockhash of the same block and thus changing observable behavior (e.g., success of settle in that block).
change_summary: Change the comparison from '>' to '>=' so settle allows settling in the same block as the locked-in block number.
